answer: Each submission hangs on the inlet of a task receipt, and the ember is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
